title: sdks: unify auth & retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, and bump versions (py/ts/go)
author: Asha Menon
description:
Summary: This PR consolidates auth + retry logic across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, improves streaming API ergonomics (particularly for client-side reconnect and backpressure), fixes several parity gaps between SDKs, and performs coordinated version bumps to 1.18.0 across packages.

Motivation: We have multiple customer reports and internal audits showing inconsistency in how auth tokens, automatic retry windows, and streaming event shapes are handled between languages. That leads to subtle bugs in prod (token refresh races, double-retry on transient 401s, and differences in chunked streaming backpressure). This change reduces maintenance, improves developer ergonomics, and unlocks a single set of test fixtures for evasion/regression checks.

What this PR does (high level):
- Extracts a small language-agnostic auth+retry contract and aligns implementations in sdk/python, sdk/typescript, and sdk/go.
- Adds guided token-refresh backoff to avoid thundering refreshes when multiple requests trigger refresh concurrently.
- Harmonizes streaming API shapes: streaming clients now expose the same event types (data, done, error, reconnect) and a small helper to resume/reconnect.
- Improves TypeScript streaming ergonomics with async-iterable wrappers and clearer TypeScript types.
- Adds Python context-manager support for streaming clients and a simple high-level "stream().map()" helper for common patterns.
- Ensures Go SDK exposes the same reconnect semantics and exposes a stable RetryPolicy struct used across clients.
- Parity fixes: small API surface alignment, naming fixes, and docstring parity for public methods.
- Bumps package versions to 1.18.0 and updates changelogs.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-2345)
- [x] Unit tests added/updated for each SDK
- [x] End-to-end streaming smoke tested against staging runtime
- [x] Integration tests for token-refresh and retry scenarios
- [x] Docs/changelog updated

Related: linear/ENG-2345, SUP-721 (support case)
commits: feat(sdk-common): add AuthTokenManager and RetryPolicy interface
refactor(python): wire AuthTokenManager into RedwoodClient; add context-manager streaming helper
feat(typescript): async-iterable streaming wrapper and reconnect helper
feat(go): add RetryPolicy struct and token refresh deduper
fix(typescript): preserve backpressure on streaming writes
test(sdk): add cross-sdk integration tests for 401-retry and token refresh
docs(changelog): bump versions to v1.18.0 and update migration notes
review_comments: Carlos Ruiz: Please add a short note in sdk/python/client.py about why we keep a weakref to the token manager to avoid cycles.
Asha Menon: Added comment and a unit test verifying no ref-cycle on GC.
Maya Patel: TS types look good, but streaming.ts needs a small tweak to preserve original chunk order when reconnecting.
Asha Menon: Fixed in commit 'fix(typescript): preserve backpressure on streaming writes'. Added e2e test.
Devon Li: Can you add a small migration note in CHANGELOG about behavior change in RetryPolicy default from 3->4 attempts? This can affect aggressive retry users.
Asha Menon: Added explicit migration note in all three CHANGELOGs and updated release notes.
Sophie Nguyen: CI flaked on go tests once (race), reran and passed. Recommend adding short timeout to the test harness.
testing_notes: Added cross-language integration test suite under sdk/integration/ that runs streaming resume and token-refresh scenarios against staging runtime.
Simulated expired tokens and concurrent refresh to validate de-dup behavior and avoid double-refresh.
Manual canary rollout on dedicated cluster (10% traffic) for 48h: no regressions observed in latency or error rate.
release_notes: SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) bumped to v1.18.0: consolidated auth + retry behavior and improved streaming ergonomics.
Streaming clients now expose consistent event types across languages and provide helpers for reconnect/resume.
Backwards-incompatible: default RetryPolicy max_attempts increased from 3 to 4 - see migration note in CHANGELOGs.
Performance: reduced token refresh storms for high-concurrency clients; smaller tail latency improvements on streaming reconnects.
post_merge_actions: Cut release artifacts for python/typescript/go packages and publish to internal registries.
Notify SDK consumers via #sdk-updates Slack channel and include migration notes.
Schedule follow-up E2E run across prod canaries for next deploy window.
